title: Venom — A reporter and a creature from space

hook.context: Jurnalist Eddie va uning ichiga kirib olgan begona mavjudot birinchi marta "biz" deb gapiradi: endi ular ikki emas, bitta. "We are" — ko'plik, chunki ikki tirik mavjudot bitta tanada.

reading: Eddie Brock is a journalist in San Francisco. He has a popular TV show where he tells the truth about powerful people.

One day Eddie interviews Carlton Drake, the head of the Life Foundation, a company that builds rockets. Eddie asks him about a secret experiment, and the interview goes badly. Eddie loses his job and his girlfriend, Anne.
The Life Foundation has brought back strange creatures from space. They are called symbiotes. A symbiote can't survive on Earth without a host, a human body to live in.
A scientist from the company asks Eddie for help. When Eddie sneaks into the laboratory, a symbiote enters his body.
Soon Eddie hears a voice in his head. The creature is called Venom. It's hungry all the time, it's very strong, and it has a terrible sense of humour.
At first Eddie is scared, but slowly they become a team. Venom learns that the Earth is not just food; it is a place worth protecting.
Together they fight against Drake and another symbiote, Riot, who wants to bring an army of creatures to the planet.

grammar.title: Artikllar: a / an / the / —
explain: **a / an** — birinchi marta tilga olinayotgan, "qandaydir bitta" sanaladigan ot: Eddie is **a** journalist. **an** — unli TOVUSH oldidan: **an** hour (h o'qilmaydi), lekin **a** university (/juː/).

**the** — tinglovchi qaysi ekanini biladi: ilgari aytilgan (A symbiote enters his body. **The** symbiote is hungry), yagona narsa (**the** Earth, **the** sun), aniqlangan (**the** head of the Life Foundation).
**Artiklsiz** — umumiy ma'nodagi ko'plik va sanalmaydigan otlar: Symbiotes need hosts. People love **music**. Shuningdek: go to **work**, at **home**, by **bus**, in **space**.
Kasb bilan doim **a/an**: He is **a** journalist (He is journalist — xato). Superlativ bilan **the**: **the** best, **the** most famous.
